integrity.reproducibility: Standalone standard-library CHECK.py verifies exhaustive 651-point and 651-line counts and the 14-line witness. Algebraic smoothness and Bezout lower bound are provided separately.

scientific_limitations: Finite exact theorem for the indicated smooth plane quartic over F25, not a classification of all optimal covers. Historical implicit coverage in older projective-geometry/code tables is possible; no independent audit.
title: A perfect fourteen-line partition of the maximal Klein quartic over twenty-five elements
